modelOverview: Introduced alongside the wider CODE 11.59 collection at SIHH 2019, the Chronograph reference houses Audemars Piguet's first in-house integrated flyback chronograph movement, the calibre 4401. The 41mm case retains the collection's signature architecture — an octagonal middle case sandwiched between a round bezel and caseback, joined by openworked lugs beneath a double-curved sapphire crystal — and is offered in precious-metal executions with lacquered dials and column-wheel chronograph counters.

26393BC.OO.A002CR.01.description: The CODE 11.59 Chronograph in 18K white gold pairs a mirror-finish lacquered black dial with the collection's octagonal-middle case and openworked lugs. It is powered by Audemars Piguet's first integrated column-wheel flyback chronograph calibre, the 4401, and worn on a matching black alligator strap. Every example is sourced and authenticated.

variants.White Gold Black: White gold case with a lacquered black dial and black alligator strap; the reference's core execution, pairing polished white gold against a deep monochrome dial for a classic dress-chronograph look.

26393OR.OO.A002CR.01.description: The CODE 11.59 Chronograph in 18K pink gold combines a lacquered black dial with warm rose-gold hour-markers, hands and logo, set within the collection's distinctive octagonal-middle case. The integrated flyback chronograph calibre 4401 drives hours, minutes, small seconds, date and chronograph functions. Sourced and authenticated prior to sale.

variants.Rose Gold Black: Pink gold case with a lacquered black dial and black alligator strap; the warm gold tone against the black dial gives this version a bolder, more traditional chronograph presence than the white-gold black-dial reference.
